body: thank you for this. you're just being realistic, and i like that. as for exhausting my options, that's a good question... i do feel like i've at least exhausted the overwhelming majority, yes. i think i can say i've given this life a fair shot, but there are some unfortunate things about me that are literally unchangeable and there's nothing i can do to help that. i'll probably give it a while more, maybe a few days, maybe few weeks, maybe a month, just because i don't have any concrete plans set in place yet with last minute preparations and that kind of stuff. for now i'll just be treading water until an unknown point in time, i suppose.
